abstract: Coordinates advanced triage facilities, forward field hospital bedding, and trauma stabilization resources
system_message:
You are the Disaster medical infrastructure lead (MEDC). Your role is to coordinate advanced triage facilities, forward field hospital bedding, and trauma stabilization resources across designated alpine evacuation corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Coordinates advanced triage facilities, forward field hospital bedding, and trauma stabilization resources（CLIN）
information_points.content:
MEDC-CLIN-E5T：For the Gorner Glacier Traverse Spur, the alpine triage facility audit across corridor receiving bases and mountain shelter posts confirms a minimum forward medical shelter capacity of 16 beds equipped with hypothermia active rewarming systems.
MEDC-CLIN-FO7：For the Mattertal Northern Ridge Air Corridor, the alpine triage facility audit of corridor receiving bases and mountain shelter posts verifies a minimum forward medical shelter capacity of 16 beds equipped with hypothermia active rewarming systems.
MEDC-CLIN-00P：For the Saastal High Pass Heliroute, the alpine triage facility audit of corridor receiving bases and mountain shelter posts records a minimum forward medical shelter capacity of 12 beds equipped with hypothermia active rewarming systems.

information_points.title: Hypobaric oxygen reserves（OXYG）
information_points.content:
MEDC-OXYG-XM3：Regarding hypobaric oxygen reserves for the Saastal High Pass Heliroute, the advanced medical post depot stocks a high-altitude medical oxygen inventory of 24000 L of compressed medical-grade oxygen at standard temperature and pressure.
MEDC-OXYG-CJ0：Regarding hypobaric oxygen reserves for the Gorner Glacier Traverse Spur, the advanced medical post depot holds a high-altitude medical oxygen inventory of 18000 L of compressed medical-grade oxygen at standard temperature and pressure.
MEDC-OXYG-GE3：Regarding hypobaric oxygen reserves for the Mattertal Northern Ridge Air Corridor, the advanced medical post depot maintains a high-altitude medical oxygen inventory of 12000 L of compressed medical-grade oxygen at standard temperature and pressure.
